# Reconstruct group_map from saved groups data and print for verification
groups = _mem['s18']
group_map = {}
for g in groups:
    gid = g['group_id']
    name = g['name']
    members = g['members']
    # Build first-name -> email mapping (lowercase first name)
    name_to_email = {}
    for m in members:
        full_name = m['name']
        # Extract first name (split by space, take first token)
        first = full_name.split()[0].lower()
        name_to_email[first] = m['email']
    group_map[name] = (gid, name_to_email)

# Print all groups with their member mappings
for gname, (gid, mapping) in group_map.items():
    print(f"Group: {gname} (id={gid})")
    for first, email in mapping.items():
        print(f"  {first}: {email}")
print("Total groups:", len(group_map))
